Do I need to know how to code to use Formspree?
Not really. AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude can generate the form markup for you in seconds — just tell it what fields you need. Create a Formspree account, grab your endpoint, drop it in, and you're live.
Can I use Formspree with my existing tech stack?
You bet. Formspree works with anything that can send an HTTP request — Next.js, Astro, Hugo, Webflow, plain HTML, whatever you're building on.
Will Formspree work for my use case?
Yes. Simple contact forms, complex form workflows with routing, integrations, and automation — Formspree handles it all. Developers, designers, marketers, and agencies all rely on it daily.
What happens if my form gets spammed?
We've got it covered. Spam filtering runs on every submission out of the box, and it's tunable — with CAPTCHA options if you need an extra layer.

pages.title: Pricing and Plans | Formspree
pages.text:
# Formspree Plans
Formspree handles form submissions for sites without a backend: point a form at a Formspree endpoint and submissions arrive by email, in the dashboard, and through integrations.
Prices are in USD. Monthly plans are billed each month; yearly plans are billed once for the year, at a lower effective monthly rate.
## Plans
### Free
For testing and development
- Monthly: $0/month
- Yearly: free
### Personal
For personal or portfolio sites
- Monthly: $15/month
- Yearly: $120/year ($10/month billed annually)
### Professional
For freelancers and startups
- Monthly: $30/month
- Yearly: $240/year ($20/month billed annually)
### Business
For organizations and agencies
- Monthly: $90/month
- Yearly: $720/year ($60/month billed annually)
### Custom
For high volume campaigns
- Pricing: contact sales
## Feature comparison

## What the features mean
- **Forms**: Make as many forms as you want. You can even group them into separate "projects" to stay organized.
- **Projects**: Group forms by project. Used to manage site-wide settings. Also used for automatic deployment by the Formspree CLI
- **Team Members**: Add a separate login for your teammates so you can work together to create and share your forms.
- **Monthly Submissions**: This is how many times a month someone fills out and submits one of your forms. Don't worry—if you need more submissions you can always upgrade.
- **Submission Archive**: If you ever miss a submission email, you can login and read your latest submissions up to the per-form archive limit.
- **Linked Emails**: Link your clients’ email addresses to your account so you can set up and manage all their forms in one place.
- **File Uploads**: You can accept up to 10 files in each form submission (each limited to 25MB). They'll be stored safely on a remote server and you'll receive links to them in your submission emails. No files will be sent directly by email.
- **Private Emails**: Hide your email address from spam-bots and human visitors: use a random string instead of your email address in the action attribute of your form.
- **Custom 'Thank You' Page**: For non-AJAX forms: By default, a user is shown a Formspree "Thank You" page after submission. You can provide an alternative URL per form to use instead. Read More.
- **Ajax Forms**: Use AJAX to submit forms — this even works cross-origin. Create a new form in your account dashboard and set the Accept header on your form to application/json.
- **Submission Export**: From the dashboard, you can export and download all submissions data as CSV or JSON.
- **Search Submissions**: Search submissions by keywords or phrases.
- **Custom reCAPTCHA**: Skip our default recaptcha page by disabling it or providing your own reCAPTCHA secret key.
- **Restrict to domain**: Restrict forms so they can only be submitted from your own website.
- **Basic Spam Filtering**: Formshield uses machine learning to block spam submissions from entering your inbox. Turn on reCAPTCHA with a single click.
- **Advanced Spam Control**: Customize Formshield to better fit your use case. Adjust the sensitivity of the automatic filter and block by categories such as profanity or cryptocurrency.
- **Custom Honeypot**: Create a custom honeypot field to catch spammers using a unique fieldname that they won't likely recognize. Read more.
- **Custom Spam Rules**: Create custom rules to discard spam that gets through our filters. Quickly neutralize a wave of spam with an identifiable pattern. Read more.
- **Basic Plugins**: Send your form submissions automatically to third-party applications like Google Sheets, Trello and more. Includes all Productivity plugins. See all our Plugins.
- **Premium Plugins**: Integrate with Premium plugins like Klaviyo, Hubspot, Zendesk and more. Includes all CRM, Newsletter, Support and Other plugins. See all our plugins.
- **API Access**: Fetch all your submissions programmatically from a JSON HTTP endpoint without having to login or share your password. Read More.
- **Autoresponses**: Send an email to submitters confirming that you've received their submission. Read More.
- **Custom Email Templates**: Customize the content and style of your submission notification and autoresponse emails. Replace the Formspree branding with your own, or customize the email markup however you like.
- **Custom Email Domains**: Make emails more recognizable and consistent with your brand by setting up a custom domain. Submission emails and autoresponses are sent from your domain instead of formspree.io
- **Rules Engine**: Dynamically route submissions to different emails, flag spam, or change the form redirect with your own logic rules. Read more.
- **Priority Support**: Support requests sent through our help center and in-app feedback forms will be placed at the top of our support queue.
- **Service Level Agreement**: Service Level Agreements are available when required and may include uptime guarantees and support response times.
- **Full-Service Onboarding**: Our engineers will roll up their sleeves and help you move your forms over to Formspree, including making the necessary changes to your website.
- **Phone Support**: Our support team will be just a phone call away to help you with any issues you encounter during business hours.
- **Auto-Verified Emails**: Skip the email verification step. New email addresses can be automatically verified allowing you to streamline new project setup and offer a fully white-labeled experience. Also removes the requirement for an unsubscribe link at the bottom of each notification email.
- **Multiple To Emails**: Send submissions to multiple email addresses
## Signing up
Create an account at https://formspree.io/register, then pick a plan at https://formspree.io/plans.

Additional Team Members
Add a separate login for your teammates so you can work together to create and share your forms.
Automation and APIs Automation and APIs
Ajax Forms Yes
Use AJAX to submit forms — this even works cross-origin. Create a new form in your account dashboard and set the Accept header on your form to application/json.
API Access Yes
Fetch all your submissions programmatically from a JSON HTTP endpoint without having to login or share your password. Read More .
Autoresponses Yes
Send an email to submitters confirming that you've received their submission. Read More .
Rules Engine Yes
Dynamically route submissions to different emails, flag spam, or change the form redirect with your own logic rules. Read more .
Privacy and Spam Privacy and Spam
Private Emails Yes
Hide your email address from spam-bots and human visitors: use a random string instead of your email address in the action attribute of your form.
Custom reCAPTCHA Yes
Skip our default recaptcha page by disabling it or providing your own reCAPTCHA secret key.
Restrict to domain Yes
Restrict forms so they can only be submitted from your own website.
Basic Spam Filtering Yes
Formshield uses machine learning to block spam submissions from entering your inbox. Turn on reCAPTCHA with a single click.
Advanced Spam Control Yes
Customize Formshield to better fit your use case. Adjust the sensitivity of the automatic filter and block by categories such as profanity or cryptocurrency.
Custom Honeypot Yes
Create a custom honeypot field to catch spammers using a unique fieldname that they won't likely recognize. Read more .
Custom Spam Rules Yes
Create custom rules to discard spam that gets through our filters. Quickly neutralize a wave of spam with an identifiable pattern. Read more .
Service and Support Service and Support
Priority Support Yes
Support requests sent through our help center and in-app feedback forms will be placed at the top of our support queue.
Phone Support Yes
Our support team will be just a phone call away to help you with any issues you encounter during business hours.
Service Level Agreement Yes
Service Level Agreements are available when required and may include uptime guarantees and support response times.
Full-Service Onboarding Yes
Our engineers will roll up their sleeves and help you move your forms over to Formspree, including making the necessary changes to your website.
